readme: Parameters — global knobs (Elo sensitivity, recency decay, dominance, prior cutoff).
Elo — central rating table from eloratings.net.
One tab per team — last corners from fotmob.
Dashboard — Adj Attack / Adj Defense at a glance.
Matchup Engine — pick two teams; get λ, over/unders, handicap.

BASE_ELO.meaning: Neutral-opponent Elo. Corner rates are normalised to an opponent of this strength.

K_ELO.meaning: Elo sensitivity for opponent normalisation. Higher = opponent strength moves rates more.

DECAY.meaning: Recency decay per match step (0-1). 0.85 = each older game ~15% less weight. 1 = no recency bias.

DOM.meaning: dominance mult strength (refit 6/30: 0.18->0.25 via 5-fold CV + residual test, n=272; was 0.18)

MIN_GAMES.meaning: Included games needed before a team uses its data instead of its prior lambda.

GFLOOR.meaning: Floor on the Elo multiplier so extreme opponents cannot blow up a normalised rate.

KNOCKOUT_LAMBDA_MULT.meaning: Multiplier on both teams' corner lambda for knockout-stage / July fixtures. Set 7/5 to 1.15 (was code default 1.1) after graded knockouts landed ~1.3 corners over model.

dashboard.team: Teams showing "PRIOR" need fotmob data pasted into their tab (currently <3 included games).
